title: Export without DDR info
description: Metadata-integrity check — files exported without DDR info ("Include details for analysis tools" was off). The import looks complete, but the catalog holds no formula references (fields, functions, custom functions, plug-in calls) for these files.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: The DDR chunk stream is the only source of formula references. A file exported without it imports without error, yet every reference from its formulas is missing — where-used, plug-in inventories and the object graph are silently blind for that file.
rule.remediation: Save the file as XML again with "Include details for analysis tools" enabled and import it again. There is nothing to repair inside FM-Lab — the information is absent from the export.
